full_judgment:
Md Joynul Abedin J: This Rule Nisi under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the results of the election of the Executive Committee Members and the election of the Office-bearers of the Executive Committee of the Baitul Mukarram Business Group published on 16-1-2003 and 19-1-2003 respectively, Annexures L and M, should not be declared to have been without lawful authority and are of no legal effect and why a direction should not be issued to hold fresh elections after necessary correction of the voter list. 

 2. The case of the petitioner is that, Baitul Mukarram Businessmen Group is an Association of the shopkeepers of the Baitul Mukarram Shopping Complex and it is licensed under the Trade Organisations Ordinance, 1961 and registered under section 26 of the Companies Act as a Trade Organisation. Recently, the government acting through the Ministry of Commerce in exercise of its power under section 8 of the Trade Organisations Ordinance issued order dated 31-7-2002 amending the Articles of Association of the Baitul Mukarram Businessmen Group (hereinafter called "the said Group") incorporating various provisions with regard to the election of the Executive Committee members and the office-bearers of the Executive Committee as well as its formation, tenure of office and other allied and related matters vide Annexure-A to the writ petition. In terms of the Articles of Association of the said Group as amended by the said order dated 31-7-2002 of the Ministry of Commerce and also the Trade Organisations Rules, 1994, elections for the Executive Committee Members as well as the office-bearers of the Executive Committee were held on 2-1-2003 and 18-1-2003 respectively for the year 2003-05. In order to hold the aforesaid two elections Election Board and Election Appellate Board were constituted and declared on 1-10-2002 and final voter list was published on 10-11-2002. After the final voter list was published the petitioners and others raised objection on various grounds as to correctness of the voter list, namely, the voter list set out the names of the voters without mentioning their TIN numbers and some members of the said Group were shown as voters in the voter list more than once on the basis of number of shops held by them in violation of Article 2(15) and (16) of the said order dated 30-1-2002 of the Ministry of Commerce which is now the part of the Articles of Association. The petitioner and others also made formal complaint to the Election Board that the said voter list also included some voters who had no shops in the Baitul Mukarram Shopping Complex and some shop-keepers were made voters against whom cases were pending. Despite the fact that the voter list was defective and incorrect as it was prepared in violation of the Articles of Association, Election Board held the election for the Executive Committee Members of the said Group on 2-1-2003 on the basis of the said defective voter list and unofficial result thereof was published on 3-1-2003, vide Annexure-G to the writ petition. Consequently, one M Hossain Khan, voter No. 384, and another member of the said Group made complaint in this regard to the Director of Trade Organisations by a letter dated nil, Annexure-D which was received by the Director on 12-1-2003 with a prayer to cancel the election of the 39 members of the Executive Committee. By the said letter, the Director of the Trade Organisations was also informed that although it was required under Article 1(2) of the said order dated 31-7-2002 of the Ministry of Commerce that the election of the office-bearers of the Executive Committee was to be held within 48 hours of the publication of the election result of the Executive Committee Members, the election for the officer-bearers of the Executive Committee was not held within 48 hours of the publication of the election result of the Executive Committee Members which was published (unofficially) on 3-1-2003. But no response was received in this regard from the Director of Trade Organisations. Meanwhile, the Election Board published the election schedule of the election of 12 office-bearers of the Executive Committee on 5-1-2003 fixing 16-1-2003 for the Election which included the President. Vice-President, General Secretary, Assistant Secretary, Treasurer. After the election of the Executive Committee Members was held on 2-1-2003 and its unofficial result was published on 3-1-2003 some members of the said Group including Haji Iqbaluddin Ahmed Majumder, voter No. 10, Haji A Latif Munshi, Voter No. 8, and Md Moshiur Rahman Litton, Voter No. 221, raised objection in writing before the Election Appeal Board on 5-1-2003, 9-1-2003 and 2-1-2003 respectively praying for recounting of the voters on the ground that counting was illegal vide Annexures I, J, K to the writ petition. The Appellate Board thereupon fixed 11-1-2003 and thereafter 15-1-2003 for recounting but ultimately, there was no recounting of votes. The Election Board nonetheless held election for the office-bearers of the Executive Committee including the President, Vice-President, etc on 18-10-2003 and the election result of this election was finally published on 19-1-2003. Before the final result of the election of the said office-bearers of the Executive Committee was published the petitioner and one Md Shahjan, Voter N.117, complained to the Chairman of the Election Appeal Board on 19-1-2003 to cancel the said election and not declare its result but in vain vide Annexures-N, N-(1), N-(2), N(3), N(4) and (N-5). In this back-ground of the matter, the petitioner filed the writ petition and obtained the present Rule.
